google_auth.title: Google Authenticator (Recommended)
google_auth.desc: Used for security verification during login, withdrawals, and security settings changes. Recommended if you frequently don't receive SMS codes.

phone_verify.title: Phone Verification
phone_verify.desc: SMS codes protect your account and transactions. After changing your phone number, features like payments and withdrawals will be disabled for 24 hours.
phone_verify.desc2: SMS codes protect your account and transactions. After changing your phone number, features like payments and withdrawals will be disabled for {{time}} hours.

email_verify.title: Email Verification
email_verify.desc: Email codes protect your account and transactions. After changing your email, features like payments and withdrawals will be disabled for 24 hours.
email_verify.desc2: Email codes protect your account and transactions. After changing your email, features like payments and withdrawals will be disabled for {{time}} hours.

login_password.title: Login Password
login_password.desc: You will be automatically logged out after resetting.

security_device.title: Trusted Devices
security_device.desc: Manage devices authorized to access your account.

security_log_item.title: Security Logs
security_log_item.desc: Monitor login IP addresses and security events.
